tasks.name: סכום לפחות 40?
tasks.note: Threshold on a total above 15: flag 15 if the sum of the list is at least 40.

tasks.name: קח כל עוד הסכום הרץ עד 25
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(s+x>25) break; s+=x; r.push(x); } return r; }
tasks.note: Longest prefix whose running sum stays within 25.

tasks.name: שליש הסכום
tasks.note: Integer division of a total above 15 by a constant (answer mod 16 as usual).

tasks.name: כמה פריטים עד שהסכום עובר 20
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0,c=0; for(const x of l){ c++; s+=x; if(s>20) break; } return c; }
tasks.note: Count items up to and including the one whose running sum passes 20 (all items if it never passes).

tasks.name: קנייה חמדנית בתקציב 40
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; const r=[]; for(const x of l){ if(s+x<=40){ s+=x; r.push(x); } } return r; }
tasks.note: Greedy: keep each item that still fits a budget of 40, skip the ones that do not, continue.

tasks.name: כמה נשאר מתקציב 50 בקנייה לפי הסדר
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=50; for(const x of l){ if(x>s) break; s-=x; } return s; }
tasks.note: Budget left after buying in order until an item does not fit (mod 16 as usual).

tasks.name: ממוצע לפחות 12?
tasks.note: Flag 15 when the floor of the mean is at least 12 (0 for an empty list).

tasks.name: הוצא מההתחלה כל עוד הסכום הרץ עד 20
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0,i=0; while(i<l.length&&s+l[i]<=20){ s+=l[i]; i++; } return l.slice(i); }
tasks.note: Drop the longest prefix whose running sum stays within 20, keep the rest.

tasks.name: הסכום חלקי 16
tasks.note: High nibble of a total that can reach 92.

tasks.name: כמה נכנסים כשכל פריט עולה x-8, תקציב 10
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0,c=0; for(const x of l){ if(s+(x-8)>10) break; s+=x-8; c++; } return c; }
tasks.note: Running total of a per-item cost (x-8) against a budget of 10: how many items fit in order.
